project.name: RuralRise AI
project.title: Rural Entrepreneurship: From Local Opportunity to Evidence-Based Decision
project.description: An AI-powered rural entrepreneurship decision assistant that helps users identify local business opportunities, evaluate business ideas, understand risks and make evidence-based decisions.
project.core_value_proposition: Don't just find a business idea. Find the right local opportunity, test the evidence, understand the risks, and make a smarter decision.
